verdict.rationale: Skills live as plain `skills/<name>/SKILL.md` markdown files (docs-15, docs-16, docs-17). The porting guide says everything in `skills/` is the source of truth and is "shared verbatim by every harness"; porting never edits SKILL.md files and only adds a tool-mapping reference and a bootstrap injector (docs-13, docs-37). Portability is backed by `~/.agents/skills/` as a cross-runtime alias, git-clone installs into Hermes, and a long list of supported harnesses (docs-31, docs-8, gh-19), though each harness needs its own install (gh-5). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of manually copying skill folders to another harness.
